logp.method_description: The log P values for 1,2 and (D)-1-MT were obtained by using the shake-flask method and GFAAS. Octanol used in this experiment was pre-saturated with PBS by overnight incubation with shaking of a biphasic mixture of the two at room temperature. A portion of 0.3 mL PBScontaining 50μM of 1 and 2 was incubated with the pre-saturated octanol (0.3 mL) in a 1.5 mL tube. The tube was shaken at room temperature for 3 h. The two phases were separated by centrifugation and the platinum content in each phase was determined by GFAAS. Owing to the low solubility of 2 in PBS, a pre-saturated octanol solutioncontaining 50 μM of the platinum compound was used instead.
